articles.title: Decentralizing the Future: The Power of Federated Learning
articles.excerpt: Federated Learning: Unlocking the power of collaborative AI without ever moving user data from local devices. Why the age of massive, centralized AI data collection is ending—and how collaborative edg…
articles.body: Federated Learning: Unlocking the power of collaborative AI without ever moving user data from local devices. Why the age of massive, centralized AI data collection is ending—and how collaborative edge training is transforming digital privacy. Over the last decade, AI progress was driven by a simple rule: bring all the data to one place. Whether training speech models on smartphone recordings or medical models on hospital records, the standard procedure required uploading vast datasets from edge devices and local systems onto a centralized server or cloud system. But as the volume and sensitivity of our data grow, this centralizing model has hit two massive roadblocks: the death of trust and the rise of data privacy laws.

articles.title: pgAdmin discovery should focus on server-mode identity and proxy trust
articles.excerpt: pgAdmin discovery should focus on server-mode identity and proxy trust pgAdmin is both a desktop application and a web application. The server mode is the deployment shape that changes the security qu…
articles.body: pgAdmin discovery should focus on server-mode identity and proxy trust pgAdmin is both a desktop application and a web application. The server mode is the deployment shape that changes the security question. Users must log in, an initial superuser is created, and file storage is scoped to each user under the configured storage directory. A public pgAdmin page therefore represents an authentication surface, not a direct database endpoint. Start with server mode pgAdmin documentation says server mode has been the default since version 2. A server-mode deployment can run behind a reverse proxy or through a WSGI interface. Users authenticate before using pgAdmin, and the initial administrator can add superusers and non-superusers.

articles.body: An official extension for Anthropic’s Claude model was backdoored and threatened as many as 5,000 developers' machines, multiple sources reported Friday. Anthropic so far has yet to warn customers of the incident. The compromised package was a VS Code extension available in the marketplace of Cursor, a maker of AI-assisted developer tools, the company said Friday. The malicious version, 2.1.313, subsequently affected “at most 5,000 users,” presumably when they either downloaded it or their systems automatically fetched and installed it. Anthropic pushed version 2.1.314 several hours after the previous version became available on Cursor, according to independent researcher Kevin Beaumont.

articles.body: Our time on our "space mission" underwater was coming to an end, and I felt like what I imagine an astronaut on the International Space Station (ISS) must feel before returning to Earth. On the other, you know you will miss your crew and the incredible experience of being in space. We did this to live and work like astronauts on the ISS .

In celebration of Halloween , we're running down some horror franchises that made the journey to the final frontier, resulting in films that range from the sublime and outrageously campy fun to just pure awful. Absent from the list are space horror movies that have space baked into their natural fabric.
